intervention: At least 7 hours of sleep regularly
main_limit: Individual need varies; longer sleep can be appropriate

intervention: Reasonably consistent sleep and wake timing
main_limit: Most long-term evidence is observational; no universal minute threshold

intervention: Outdoor morning light and lower evening light
main_limit: Healthy-adult evidence is heterogeneous and often observational; no universal duration

intervention: 150-300 minutes moderate or 75-150 minutes vigorous aerobic activity
main_limit: A range rather than an individualized program

intervention: Strengthen all major muscle groups across at least 2 days
broad_outcome: Strength; function; bone and metabolic health
main_limit: Exact exercises and volume must be individualized

intervention: Move more and sit less; activity bouts of any length count
main_limit: No universal sitting-break interval

intervention: Minimally processed varied nutrient-dense food pattern
key_source: WHO Healthy Diet 2026; 2025-2030 US Dietary Guidelines
main_limit: No single culturally universal menu

intervention: At least 400 g vegetables and fruit and 25 g naturally occurring fiber
main_limit: Increase fiber gradually; individual GI tolerance varies

intervention: Protein at least 0.8 g/kg/day; about 1.2-1.6 g/kg/day when resistance training or prioritizing muscle
main_limit: Upper range is a training target not a universal longevity dose; medical conditions and weight far from a healthy or intended range can change the calculation; powder is a convenience not a nutritionally interchangeable meal

intervention: Water as default; drink to thirst and conditions
main_limit: No evidence-based universal volume; thirst can be less reliable in some older adults or conditions

intervention: Test every home for radon at least once if status is unknown; retest after major changes
main_limit: Testing does not reduce exposure by itself; mitigation depends on the result and applicable action threshold

intervention: Use an exposure-triggered wildfire-smoke and PM2.5 plan; compatible MERV 13 or portable HEPA when needed
main_limit: No universal purifier purchase; fit; sizing; building system compatibility and source control matter; avoid ozone-generating devices

intervention: Clean; separate; cook; and chill
main_limit: Specific temperatures and handling rules vary by food and higher-risk population

intervention: Do not use tobacco; do not start nicotine for optimization
broad_outcome: Mortality; cancer; cardiovascular and respiratory health
main_limit: Nicotine replacement for cessation is different from recreational use

intervention: Minimize alcohol; zero is the lowest-exposure option
broad_outcome: Cancer; injury; organ and mental-health risk
main_limit: Risk varies by dose and pattern; most harm is concentrated in heavier use

intervention: Brush twice daily about 2 minutes with fluoride toothpaste
main_limit: Technique and individual risk still matter

intervention: Clean between teeth once daily with a fitted method
main_limit: Device comparisons and long-term caries or periodontitis outcomes are low certainty

intervention: Broad-spectrum SPF 30+ plus clothing/shade for exposed skin
main_limit: Photoaging RCT was one population and did not measure lifespan or wrinkle counts

intervention: Gentle cleansing and moisturizer according to need
main_limit: Does not independently establish anti-aging or systemic-health benefit

intervention: Basic hair; body; nail; and foot hygiene
main_limit: Cadence is need-dependent; limited direct long-term outcome evidence

intervention: Recurring high-quality social connection and community participation
broad_outcome: Mental health; quality of life; mortality association
key_source: US Surgeon General Social Connection Advisory
main_limit: Much outcome evidence is observational; no validated universal dose or daily quota

intervention: Learning or cognitively challenging activity for enjoyment and function
key_source: WHO Dementia Risk-Reduction Guideline Second Edition
main_limit: Cognitive-function effects are small or uncertain; no demonstrated dementia-incidence benefit or validated dose

intervention: Repeatable mindfulness; breathing; therapy skill; yoga; nature; or quiet leisure when it reduces stress
broad_outcome: Perceived stress; anxiety; quality of life
main_limit: Effects vary and do not prove anti-aging or telomere benefit

intervention: Vaccinations and evidence-based age/risk/anatomy-appropriate screening
main_limit: Schedules change and are individualized

intervention: Adult blood-pressure screening with out-of-office confirmation after an elevated result
broad_outcome: Cardiovascular risk detection and treatment pathway
main_limit: Optimal interval varies; a normal screen does not require habitual home checking

intervention: Sexual and reproductive prevention matched to goals and exposures; contraception or pregnancy planning; barriers; HIV/STI testing when applicable
broad_outcome: HIV/STI prevention and detection; reproductive planning
key_source: CDC STI Testing; CDC STI Prevention
main_limit: No universal test or contraception cadence; anatomy; practices; partners; symptoms; pregnancy and local risk matter

intervention: Confirm abnormal screening findings and act through an evidence-based care pathway
main_limit: The correct confirmation and treatment pathway depends on the finding; repeated self-testing is not a substitute

intervention: Risk-appropriate dental; vision; hearing; and medication review
main_limit: Not every service is annual or universal

intervention: Caffeine at lowest effective dose; usually finish at least 8 hours before bed; no more than 400 mg/day for most healthy adults
main_limit: Sensitivity varies; high doses can impair sleep even 12 hours before bed

intervention: Creatine monohydrate 3-5 g/day with resistance training
main_limit: Water weight; GI effects; serum creatinine artifact; direct-imaging hypertrophy effect is very small or uncertain and the review reports industry-related conflicts; not a universal health need

intervention: Prescription topical tretinoin for facial photodamage
main_limit: Irritation; prescription; not a systemic anti-aging intervention

intervention: Routine multivitamin; vitamin D; omega-3; magnesium; iron; B12; probiotic; greens stack without a demonstrated need
main_limit: Value depends on diet; life stage; deficiency; risk; or condition

intervention: Routine CGM; microbiome; genetic; biological-age; telomere; methylation; or broad biomarker panels in healthy adults
main_limit: False positives; noise; cost; weak actionability

intervention: Cold plunge; sauna; red light; PEMF; hyperbaric oxygen as a universal routine
main_limit: Does not outrank core; broad healthspan efficacy unproven

intervention: Hormones; peptides; hair-loss; acne; antifungal; periodontal; glucose; blood-pressure; or weight-loss treatment without an indication
main_limit: Effective treatment can still be inappropriate without the relevant diagnosis or risk plan
